defect: CPU_NextState and CPU_SetState change cpuThreadState and notify the condition variable without holding cpuThreadLock, so a waiter can check its predicate, miss the notify and sleep forever (lost wakeup, e.g. on shutdown).
reason: The fix adds the lock_guard to exactly these state setters added by this change; the unlocked set+notify against a locked predicate wait is visible in the diff.

defect: LockRect is called with D3DLOCK_DISCARD for every level, although the texture is D3DPOOL_MANAGED/usage 0 on non-Ex devices and DISCARD is only valid on dynamic textures and the top level, so the lock fails and the code writes through an invalid rect.
reason: The fix restricts DISCARD to level 0, always creates dynamic textures and checks the lock result, repairing the crash introduced by the two changed LockRect lines.

defect: The new Jit_TcU8ToFloat converts the u8 texcoords with plain UCVTF and omits the 1/128 scale that Step_TcU8ToFloat applies, giving wrong UVs on ARM64.
reason: The fix adds the fixed-point scale (UCVTF ..., 7) to the function this change added; seeing the required scale needs the reference step in VertexDecoderCommon.cpp.

defect: The split skip check returns on SKIPDRAW_SKIPFRAME before SetRenderFrameBuffer, so with frameskip the new unbuffered logic (dirtyAfterDisplay, NON_DISPLAYED_FB tracking in SetRenderFrameBuffer) is not updated and frameskip breaks unbuffered rendering.
reason: The same-day fix moves the SKIPFRAME test after SetRenderFrameBuffer in exactly the lines this change rewrote; the dependency on SetRenderFrameBuffer's bookkeeping is in Framebuffer.cpp.

defect: ToShortFriendlyPath calls path_.ToVisualString() on a std::string member, which does not compile on non-UWP builds.
reason: The fix wraps it as Path(path_).ToVisualString(); path_ is visibly a std::string in the surrounding diff.

defect: The commit renames ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1/FRAMESKIP_1 to ..._AUTO in resource.h and WndMainWindow.h but leaves case ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1: setFrameSkipping(FRAMESKIP_1) in the command handler, a Windows compile error.
reason: The fix renames the stale case to ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_AUTO/FRAMESKIP_AUTO; confirming the removed identifiers needs resource.h and WndMainWindow.h of the same commit.

defect: The color test emits round255f(v.rgb), passing a vec3 to the float-only round255f, so the generated GLSL fails to compile when color test equality is used.
reason: The fix adds a vec3 round255v and uses it in the line this change added; the scalar helper is used on v.a just above.

defect: Exists() dereferences cache_ unconditionally, but the constructor leaves cache_ null when the file size is 0, so it crashes (e.g. for missing or unreachable http files).
reason: The fix adds the cache_ null check to the line this change added; the constructor shown in the diff makes the null case visible.

defect: Centralizing vsync makes the GPUCommon constructor call UpdateVsyncInterval(true), which calls gfxCtx_->SwapInterval even when headless runs with a null graphics context (crash), and adds lastVsync_ without an initializer.
reason: The fix commit null-checks gfxCtx_ in the code this commit added to GPUCommon.cpp and initializes the lastVsync_ member it added here; the crash itself is only visible in GPUCommon.cpp.

defect: progressBar_ (and doneView_) are now only created for ZIPs with PSP content, but update() still dereferences progressBar_ unguarded in the non-idle branch, crashing when the game manager is busy on a non-PSP ZIP screen.
reason: The fix adds the missing null check in the branch the change left unguarded; the conditional creation and partial guarding are both in the diff.

defect: The new Comp_Vmtvc maps VFPU register vs with MapRegV but stores fpr.RX(vs), the FPU-register accessor, so the wrong host register is written to the VFPU control register.
reason: The fix replaces RX with VX in the added line; the MapRegV/RX mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix replaces the change's sleep-wait in SetGame with a real start delay (IsReadyToStart), because the login callback runs on the main thread and the wait never let login finish.
reason: The repaired problem (achievements not activating when started from frontends while login is pending) existed before this change; the change only added an ineffective workaround that the fix replaces.

defect: Allowing re-attachment when entry->invalidHint == -1 makes exact-match render-to-texture re-attach framebuffers to invalid entries repeatedly, causing map flickering in Tactics Ogre.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the condition this change added to fix the reported regression; the effect only shows at runtime in specific games.

defect: The SINGLEDELETE case writes if(param.Delete(param.GetPspParam()), param.GetSelectedSave()), so Delete is called without the selected save and the comma operator makes the condition the save index.
reason: The fix moves the parenthesis in the line this change added; the misplaced parenthesis is plain in the diff.

defect: The new 16-to-32-bit reinterpret samples the left pixel at v_texcoord and the right at +0.5/texSize.x instead of offsetting both by a quarter, so it reads the wrong source texels.
reason: The fix changes the offsets to -0.25 and +0.25 in the sampling lines this change added; judging the offsets needs the texSize/draw-size convention of the Draw2D code.

defect: The chat feature stores the ChatMenu pointer via setChatPointer when opening it but never clears it when the screen is destroyed, so proAdhoc's friend-finder thread calls ch->UpdateChat() on a freed screen and crashes.
reason: The fix adds a ChatMenu destructor that clears the pointer (and simplifies the TextView layout); the dangling pointer comes from EmuScreen.cpp and proAdhoc.cpp of this commit.

defect: The new context-switch log format ends with pc: %08) with no conversion character, an invalid printf specifier (undefined behaviour, garbled log).
reason: The fix adds the missing x to the format string this change wrote.

defect: BrowseAndBoot passes the default directory as the in/out filename fn instead of the initial-folder argument, and the memstick path lacks a trailing backslash, so the dialog does not open in PSP/GAME.
reason: The fix passes defaultPath as BrowseForFileName's initial-directory argument and adds the backslash; the parameter roles are defined in W32Util.

defect: DxState3::set and restore pass p2 for the third render state instead of p3, so e.g. stencilOp's pass op and stencilFunc's mask get the wrong value.
reason: The fix uses p3 for _state3 in the line this new file added; the copy-paste slip is visible in the diff.

defect: The new TextDrawerSDL destructor calls FcFini(), which is known to crash when fontconfig objects are still referenced (e.g. when the text drawer is recreated).
reason: The fix removes the FcFini() call this change added; the crash depends on fontconfig library behaviour not shown in the code.

defect: With FindReplacement now returning nullptr when there is no replacement, the check replaced && replaced->IsInvalid() sends the null case to the else branch, which sets match = false and forces a texture reload every time.
reason: The fix only acts when replaced is non-null, restoring the old none-texture behaviour of the lines this change rewrote; the else branch taken on null is visible in the diff.

defect: The scissored-clear support disables GL_SCISSOR_TEST after a scissored clear and no longer re-enables it after an unscissored one, so the scissor test is left off after clears.
reason: The fix keeps the scissor test enabled across the clear in the lines this change wrote; the inverted restore logic is visible against the removed glEnable.

defect: The new sceHeap implementation dereferences heapList[heapAddr] without a null check in sceHeapGetTotalFreeSize, permanently changes the allocator grain via Setgrain_, returns 0 instead of an error for bad heaps and never clears heapList on init.
reason: The fix adds the null check, uses AllocAligned with a local grain, returns INVALID_ID and clears the list, all repairing code this change added.

defect: The input-attachment case picks RP_TYPE_COLOR_INPUT when depth/stencil is used and RP_TYPE_COLOR_DEPTH_INPUT when it is not, the reverse of what is needed.
reason: The fix swaps the ternary in the line this change added; the inversion is visible next to the correct non-input ternary.

defect: The added ext.substr(1) strips the dot from the extension while the filter set is built with a leading dot, so no file matches and filtered zip listings come back empty (post shaders missing on Android).
reason: The fix removes the added substr; the function context shows filters.insert("." + tmp).

defect: sceKernelRegisterSubIntrHandler uses else if (error = SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_FOUND_HANDLER), an assignment that overwrites any other error with FOUND_HANDLER, and the release error log lacks its error argument.
reason: The fix changes = to == and passes the missing argument in the lines this change added.

defect: The binary search that replaces the linear scan drops the !invalid check and assumes normalEntry is sorted, but DestroyBlock zeroes normalEntry of invalidated blocks, so lookups fail or return invalid blocks.
reason: The fix re-adds the invalid check and stops zeroing normalEntry; the dropped invalid check is visible in the diff.

defect: FileNode::DoState now calls p.Section("FileNode", 2), so the minimum version is 2 and savestates with FileNode version 1 no longer load, although the code has an s >= 2 compatibility branch.
reason: The fix changes the section to (1, 2); the useless s >= 2 check makes the mistake visible in the diff.

defect: The directional-light prenormalization computes len = 1/length and then divides by it, multiplying the vector by its length instead of normalizing it.
reason: The fix multiplies by the inverse length in the line this change added.

defect: ResizeFramebufFBO copies VirtualFramebuffer old = *vfb only after updating bufferWidth/renderWidth, so the blit from the old FBO uses the new dimensions.
reason: The fix moves the snapshot before the size update in the function this change added.

defect: PackFramebufferD3D11_ computes srcByteOffset but never applies it, so readbacks of a sub-rectangle copy from the top-left of the staging texture.
reason: The fix adds srcByteOffset to the source pointer in the line this change added; the unused variable is visible.

defect: Wrapping the wait/signal semaphore functions in WrapI_ writes their return value to $v0 after they have already switched threads, so the result lands in the wrong thread's register.
reason: The fix goes back to WrapV_ wrappers for these functions; that they reschedule inside is only visible in sceKernelSemaphore.cpp.

defect: The added warm-up returns ERROR_MPEG_NO_DATA from sceMpegAvcDecode and sceMpegAtracDecode, which breaks video playback in Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.
reason: The fix moves the warm-up from the decode functions this change edited to GetAvcAu/GetAtracAu; the game-specific HLE behaviour is not visible from code.

defect: Update() now sets status = FINISHED whenever status is not RUNNING, so INITIALIZE and SHUTDOWN states are forced back to FINISHED and the dialog state machine never completes properly.
reason: The same-day fix removes the added assignment; overwriting any non-running status is visible in the diff.

defect: ReadAt loops while readSize < bytes without clamping to the file size or checking progress, so a read past end of file never makes progress and loops forever.
reason: The fix breaks out when ReadFromCache returns 0, repairing the loop this new file added.

defect: The stb_image path allocates and copies x*y*n bytes, where n is the file's original component count, though stbi_load was asked for 4 components, so RGB images give a buffer that is too small.
reason: The fix uses 4 bytes per pixel in the lines this change added; the comment beside them says n is the original count.

defect: ThreadFrame now returns false whenever the render queue is momentarily empty, but callers such as SDLMain's main loop treat false as a request to exit and break out.
reason: The fix makes ThreadFrame return true again (and block until a frame is presented); the callers' exit-on-false use is in SDL/Windows code, not in this file.

defect: ApplyWaveformEffect stores 32-bit send-buffer samples into the s16 downsample buffer without clamping, so loud samples wrap around and the reverb sounds like a buzzsaw.
reason: The fix wraps the stores in clamp_s16 in the function this change added; the s32-to-s16 narrowing is visible from the buffer types.

defect: The fix adds the missing +4 (delay-slot base) to the branch-target formula in GetBranchTarget and in the new GetBranchTargetNoRA, plus a jump-target masking fix.
reason: The new function copies the existing off-by-4 formula of GetBranchTarget, which its only caller used before, so the wrong targets already existed before this change.

defect: The condition now accepts NV_framebuffer_blit, but in MAY_HAVE_GLES3 builds it still calls the GLES3 glBlitFramebuffer on non-GLES3 devices, and the #else branch calls glBlitFramebufferNV on platforms without it.
reason: The fix selects glBlitFramebuffer only for GLES3 and the NV function only on Android with the extension; the mismatched #ifdef structure is visible in the diff.
